The app now learns how to read your bank SMS from your corrections, entirely on the phone.

- **Fix how this SMS is read**: from a transaction's detail sheet, mark what the message is (purchase, bill/transfer, cash withdrawal, credit/refund, own-account move, statement, declined, OTP/notice) and correct its merchant, amount and card/account digits.
- **One correction fixes the whole bank format**: every SMS from the same sender with the same wording is read the same way, including future imports.
- **Unparsed messages**: Settings → Unparsed messages has a "Teach how to read this" link on each message.
- A message-type classifier learns from your corrections and overrides the built-in rules only for types you have labelled, when it is at least 90% sure.
- Amounts written in Arabic digits (١٬٢٥٠٫٥٠) are now parsed. Existing transactions are re-parsed automatically on first launch after updating.
- Nothing changes until you save a correction. SMS text still never leaves the device.

APK: arm64-v8a, built by GitHub Actions.
